title: Production Design
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 30S/45Q to fewer than 60S/90Q units

not_verbatim: Apply principles of production design, visual storytelling, and script analysis to create cohesive design concepts for film, television, and digital media.
Design and develop immersive theatrical environments, including scenery, props, costumes, and spatial layouts, that support live performance, collaboration, and audience engagement.

Develop a professional production design portfolio that demonstrates creative design, visual storytelling, spatial and aesthetic problem-solving, collaborative practice, budgeting awareness, and the ability to create cohesive design concepts for film, theater, television, and/or multimedia productions.
